title: Brushkeep
tagline: Make space for your next world.
features: Orbitable orthographic 3D and editable XY views
Browser autosave and editable JSON projects
OBJ geometry and experimental Quake MAP export
compatibility: Own Brushkeep JSON format only for import. OBJ is untextured Z-up cuboid geometry without entities. Quake standard MAP export is experimental, uncompiled, and not verified in TrenchBroom or an engine. Materials are placeholder names, not included game textures.
